messages:
Alice K: FYI posted a short postmortem for the token undercount that hit ingestion on 2026-02-05..02-06. Need owners for backfill, invoice corrections, and a monitoring plan. https://redwood.internal/pm/MP-2026-token-undercount
Mateo R: saw it. Any ballpark on affected volume? Is this mostly new ingestion lag or a schema mismatch?
Jin L: Looks like a windowing bug in the streaming consumer that dropped late-arriving events when shard rebalances occurred. Preliminary: ~8M tokens missing across ~90 accounts. Will validate after backfill.
Nora B: I'll take customer-facing comms with Priya. We should segment messages by impacted billing model (PAYG vs reserved).
Sam (finance): Please include a suggested credit calc. We need a draft accounting memo for quarterly close if credits exceed $5k per account.
Priya S: I can lead invoice remediation. Requesting: CSV with account_id, period_start, period_end, orig_billed_tokens, corrected_tokens, token_delta, estimated_credit_usd. Also a brief explanation blurb we can paste into emails.
Jin L: Plan for backfill: 1) deploy consumer fix (today EOD) 2) run idempotent ingest job for 02/05-02/06 window on staging (tomorrow) 3) validation + reconcile script then prod backfill. I estimate corrected deltas CSV by 2026-03-02. Edge-case risk: duplicate dedupe rules differing between staging/prod.
Mateo R: I'll add an alert rule for consumer lag and a dashboard panel for late-arriving-event counts. Will open PR with alert and runbook snippet by 2026-02-28. Also propose a 2-week increased monitoring cadence post-fix.
Alice K: Can we get explicit ownership + dates here so finance can plan outreach?
Jin L: Ownership: ingestion fix + backfill + CSV -> Jin L -> due 2026-03-02 EOD. Will include logs and a small validation report (sample diff for top 20 accounts).
Priya S: Invoice corrections + customer emails -> Priya S & Nora B -> draft by 2026-03-04, final send after accounting sign-off.
Sam (finance): Accounting sign-off on credits -> Sam (finance) -> target 2026-03-05. Also will prepare a credit threshold policy doc for future incidents.
Mateo R: Monitoring + weekly sweep for 4 weeks -> Mateo R -> PR by 2026-02-28, sweep schedule in remediation spreadsheet.
billing-bot: JIRA-4682 created: "Token undercount 2026-02-05..06". Labels: billing, metering, monitoring. Priority: P2.
Alice K: Extra prevention action: add proactive weekly ingestion-lag report to SRE runbook and add unit tests around consumer rebalance handling. Who picks those?
Jin L: I'll add the consumer unit tests and a short doc on rebalance semantics. Due 2026-03-09.
Nora B: For comms: suggest two templates: one concise email for small credits (<$100) and a personalized outreach flow for larger credits. We should loop legal for wording on refunds.
Sam (finance): Agreed. I'll loop legal and attach a sample accounting memo once I see the CSV.
Priya S: Scheduling a 30m review for communications + accounting on 2026-03-03 09:30PT. Invites shortly.
Alice K: Status check on 2026-03-03 10:30PT in #finance. If anything slips, escalate to me. Thanks all. :rocket:
Jin L: Starting prod backfill dry-run today on a small shard to verify idempotence. Will post logs + CSV excerpt in JIRA-4682 when ready.
Mateo R: PR for monitoring opened: https://git.internal/redwood/alerts/pull/342 link includes query and alert thresholds.
Sam (finance): Received sample CSV (top 10 accounts). Looks sane, will compute suggested credits and share draft memo by EOD tomorrow.
Priya S: Thanks. Once I have the full CSV, I'll stitch invoices and the customer FAQ.
Alice K: Closing loop: action owners listed in the PM doc as well. We'll keep this thread for quick status updates only.
